title: From Lego's Hometown to Art Deco Lakefront! | 4 NEW MSFS Marketplace Airports
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just rolled out a fresh set of four featured airport arrivals for flight simmers looking to expand their global route network! Today, we take an honest, in-depth look across Scandinavia, the British Isles, the Gulf Coast of North America, and Northwest China—ranging from bustling international passenger and cargo terminals to vintage waterside approaches.

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive into the details to evaluate whether these four distinct destinations deserve a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ SCANDINAVIAN INTERNATIONAL HUB (BILLUND AIRPORT - EKBI): Originally founded by the son of the Lego Group founder as a private 800-meter company strip, Billund has evolved into Denmark's second-busiest international airport. This detailed package features realistic handmade terminals, detailed PBR ground markings, modeled passenger concourses with landside shops, cargo complexes, custom GSE, animated screens, and built-in GSX compatibility for realistic commercial and cargo turns.

✈️ SOUTHEAST IRELAND REGIONAL STRIP (WATERFORD AIRPORT - EIWF): Located in Killowen just outside Waterford city, this coastal airfield serves as the only airport in southeast Ireland. Developed utilizing the free UK2000 common library, this rendition brings authentic weathering, landside vehicle detailing, static helicopters, and true-to-life apron wear for quiet regional VFR and general aviation hops.

✈️ HISTORIC GULF COAST ART DECO HUB (NEW ORLEANS LAKEFRONT - KNEW): Conceived during aviation's golden age as the Air Hub of the Americas and famously visited by Amelia Earhart, Lakefront Airport sits along the shores of Lake Pontchartrain. Featuring authentic 1930s Art Deco terminal architecture, high-resolution PBR textures, custom ground polygons, adjacent harbor and marina detailing, and weathered general aviation aprons.

✈️ NORTHWEST CHINA DOMESTIC OUTPOST (KHAMI YIZHOU AIRPORT - ZWHM): Expanding the regional network deep within Xinjiang, China, this joint civil-military airport features weathered terminal buildings and updated aprons, perfect for simmers looking to explore growing domestic route schedules in East Asia.

Will you be adding the modern passenger gates of Billund to your airliner routes, shooting vintage approaches into New Orleans Lakefront, or exploring the regional strips? Let me know in the comments below!
